analyst_feedback_summary: For the next round, propose a small set of SEIRS|fractional=0|obs=delayed_I variants that primarily differ by delay (test 1,2,3,4 weeks) and otherwise keep the template unchanged to isolate timing effects. If adding any new template, make it a single, minimal modification aimed at improving rolling robustness (e.g., one alternative observation mapping closely related to delayed_I), and avoid SEIHR-style hospitalization-explicit mappings unless you can justify how they will reduce the rolling generalization gap for this age group.

For the next round, keep the core SEIRS (non-fractional) but reduce reliance on delay tuning: propose a small set centered on delay=0–2, and include at least one delay=0 alternative observation mapping (i.e., not delayed_I) to address phase alignment more robustly. Do not introduce higher-complexity structures; aim for templates that maintain stable performance across rolling splits rather than optimizing a single validation window.
